title: Chemically synthesized biofuels from agricultural waste: Optimization operating parameters with surface response methodology (CCD)
author: Berhe, Sahu

steps.title: Prepare fermentation medium
steps.instruction: Make 100 mL of medium containing 10 g dextrose, 0.2 g yeast extract, 1.0 g urea, and 1.0 g MgSO₄·7H₂O; sterilize by autoclaving.

steps.title: Inoculate medium with yeast and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 g of Saccharomyces cerevisiae to the sterilized medium in a 250 mL conical flask, cover with aluminum foil, and place in a shaking incubator at 30 °C, 200 rpm for 24 h.

steps.title: Soak sugarcane bagasse in water
steps.instruction: Weigh 50 g of sugarcane bagasse (SCB) and soak it in 500 mL distilled water in a conical flask for 24 h; cap the flask with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Steam‑pretreat bagasse at 121 °C
steps.instruction: Transfer the soaked bagasse to an autoclave and heat rapidly to 121 °C with high‑pressure steam (no chemicals) for 15 min to hydrolyze hemicellulose.

steps.title: Separate soluble and insoluble fractions
steps.instruction: Allow the autoclave to cool, then separate the soluble portion from the non‑soluble residue.

steps.title: Acid hydrolyze insoluble fraction
steps.instruction: Hydrolyze the non‑soluble residue with dilute sulfuric acid (either 1 % or 5 % w/v) adjusted to pH 5; place in the autoclave at a temperature between 80 °C and 100 °C for 30–60 min.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1 % or 5 % H₂SO₄ solution and adjust to pH 5.
Load the residue into the autoclave.
Set temperature to 80‑100 °C and hold for 30‑60 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge and filter hydrolysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the hydrolyzed mixture, then filter the super‑natant to remove solid particles and non‑fermentable lignin.

steps.title: Ferment hydrolysate with yeast
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the filtered hydrolysate to 30 °C (using a water‑filled beaker), add yeast culture at a 1:10 (yeast : hydrolysate) ratio, cover the vessel with a piece of ginned cotton and aluminum foil, and incubate at 30 °C for 72 h.

substeps.instruction: Add Saccharomyces cerevisiae at 1 part yeast to 10 parts hydrolysate.

steps.title: Distill fermented broth to recover ethanol
steps.instruction: After 72 h fermentation, distill the broth to separate water from ethanol.
